headline: EvoAir Holdings Inc. disclosed substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern
label: Going concern
quote: Management continues to evaluate its funding requirements and implement measures to support the Company’s operations and long-term growth objectives. However, the successful implementation of these plans, particularly the availability of additional financing, remains subject to factors beyond the Company’s control. Accordingly, management has concluded that these conditions raise substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern within one year after the date the consolidated financial statements are issued.
